title: Writer React Parity
description: Get writer's react renderer to premigration level (git tag `premigration`, where writer/react/index.tsx was a 1542-line React renderer with WriterCanvas: jack AST tree, selectable spans, symbol occurrences/rename, placeholders, newline gating, completions, context menu, keyboard navigation, window measures/engagement, toolbar) on the migrated Rust plugin architecture: writer/plugin/rs emits a TextEditorScene UiTree interpreted by framework/renderer/react's text-editor-host.tsx, backed by the framework/editor/rs GPU editor session. Follow the approach of PUZZLE-2D-REACT-PARITY and PUZZLE-3D-REACT-PARITY (26/07/09).
